description: Hand-charted ground truth for the 10 tiebreak points of videoplayback.mp4 (Beijing 2024 final, 3rd-set tiebreak). A = Sinner (top row of score bug), B = Alcaraz, both right-handed. Server, side, ends and winner come from the score bug and are certain. t_start/t_end = the rally windows the pipeline passes to chart_point. fault_windows = separate short main-camera shots earlier in the same point that show a 1st-serve fault (the in-window serve is then n=2). Every shot was charted by eye (E5b) from 10-25 fps frame strips, zoom crops and ball-trail composites (3-frame-difference blobs coloured by time). shots[].t = contact time (+-0.1 s), by = hitter, wing fh/bh (null for serves), stroke serve/groundstroke/volley/overhead/slice. rally_len = MCP count (shots incl. the serve that started the rally; a 1st-serve fault is not counted). null = not knowable from the video.
